verdict.rationale: Zamzar publishes a documented public REST API. The docs cover a `jobs` endpoint for conversions, Bearer or Basic API-key authentication, separate sandbox and production endpoints, an official Java SDK and tested code samples, so the product can be driven programmatically. Probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt, which limits machine-readable discovery for AI agents but does not contradict the documented API. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: To convert a file with Zamzar, you need to send a request to the `jobs` endpoint.
Use HTTP Bearer authentication (passing your API key as the bearer token) or HTTP Basic authentication (specifying your API key as the username and leaving the password blank).
If you want to use the production environment change the endpoint to `https://api.zamzar.com/`.
Use our official Java SDK for convenient access to all features of the API.
